comment: FX-17. Backup set ids the controller mints (a manual run's UUID; a scheduled run's <schedule uid>-<yyyymmdd>-<hhmmss>, -r<k> for a retry) and near misses it never mints. Read by crates/logweir-core/tests/check_contract.rs (the redactor keeps every minted id whole and withholds every near miss) and by ui/tests/restore-catalog.spec.js (isMintedSetId agrees). The scheduled values are the PoC's own (logweir-poc). `identityEdges` are ids the controller never mints that both sides still read as identities, so their agreement is pinned too (review L-4): an upper-case bare UUID (is_uuid takes any hex digit), the year 0000 and 0099, and a leap second, all of which chrono's round trip accepts.
